decisions.reason: The construction site dumper was only mentioned on the website and is close to the vehicle business the firm already left with A and B, so its value is doubtful, but with little evidence and a low cost of keeping it, the option stays open for now.
The inclined furniture lift line has several models and its own page, fits the firm's lifting know-how and service network, and costs little to keep while its market value becomes clearer.
The inclined building material lift line shares technology and customers with the furniture lifts, so keeping it is cheap and it adds variety to the lifting portfolio.
The truck-mounted furniture lift extends the lifting range at modest extra cost, and no results so far show that its value will not be realized.
